# Composite side — unit and log weighted

- `comp_unit(r)` = 2^(r-1) − (count of primes in regime r)
- `comp_log(r)`  = Σ ln n over **composites** in regime r  = [ln(2^r!) − ln(2^(r-1)!)] − Σ ln p
